_comment: Registry of the payroll readiness checklist (slice S1.34a, CR-087; FR-HRM-PAY-38). Each item names its code, the text key of its label, the slice that owns its check and the requirement it serves. A check is a class implementing IPayReadinessCheck with the same code, registered in the host: an item listed here without a registered check shows as 'not available' and is never counted as passed. A later slice adds its item here and registers its check (attendance locked: S1.31, FR-XM-26; loans: S1.41; claims: S1.42). The order of this list is the order of the checklist.
